title: Security fix for GHSA-gcjh-h69q-9w9g applied in: yunikorn-k8shim 1.8.0-r5
description: A security vulnerability affecting the yunikorn-k8shim package has been identified and resolved in version 1.8.0-r5. The vulnerability has a CVSS 4.0 base score of 6.3, indicating a medium severity issue. The flaw allows network-based exploitation without user interaction but requires partial attack complexity and privileges. No known exploits are reported in the wild.
